description.value: Sushi Den is a Japanese fast-food sushi restaurant in downtown Vancouver's Crosstown neighbourhood offering takeout sushi with no drive-through. The restaurant has no official website of its own — a local fan built an unofficial site just to make the menu viewable on mobile. Touring cyclists passing through the downtown core will find it a quick stop for takeout sushi a few blocks from the False Creek seawall.
